study type: National surveillance study and retrospective case collection
exposure: High usage of perinatal antibiotics in mothers
Short term of antibiotics (after initial infection)
cohort: The study participants were infants diagnosed with recurrent invasive GBS disease (n=25) and those with invasive GBS disease occurring in parallel in twins/triplets (n=32).
finding: High usage of perinatal antibiotics in mothers of affected multiples and a short term of antibiotics for the initial infection were associated with an increased risk of recurrent iGBS or iGBS in multiples, suggesting individual microbiome disturbances and host immunity fluctuations contribute to disease development.
